stateDescription: The document exactly as the server sent it. The zero-second meta refresh fired and its navigation was aborted, so the parsed document is unmodified.

disabledRules.reason: S4 is a three-paragraph recovery document with no content to head. Adding an <h1> would give a noindex page a heading it does not need.
Same: S4 is a static document, not a route. 04.2 D-12 defines it as minimal, and "just one more element" is the drift that definition exists to prevent.
Follows from the two above — with no landmarks by design, all content is necessarily outside one.

interventions: aborted the refresh destination navigation to https://www.haoo.online/ so the served document stayed in the browser
